description: CI health, the same as GET /api/v2/ci/health and /admin/ci: status, the four paging rules, queue wait p50/p95 by work class, outcome rates, capacity. Site admins (admin scope) also get `dashboard` (CAP-0.4) for 24 h and 7 d: startTimes (queue → start p50/p95 by class and pool), duplicateMinutes (lease time on a tree, workflow and job that already had a green job), poolCost (minutes per pool; a cost only where CI_POOL_COST_PER_MINUTE sets one, else 'cost not configured'), notMerged (merge-train dequeue and auto-merge reasons, counted), nonBillable (platform repositories on our machines vs customers'). Every number carries `source`: the table or setting it was read from. Read-only.
name: gluecron_ci_health
